test_document_tokenizer: test the DocumentTokenizer class to tokenize documents with a specified tokenizer and shuffle options
test_document_tokenizer_merger: test the DocumentTokenizerMerger class to merge tokenized document chunks into a single dataset
test_check_dataset: test the check_dataset function to validate the consistency of a tokenized dataset folder
test_load_doc_ends: test the load_doc_ends function to extract document boundary indices from an index file
test_get_texts_from_tokens: test the get_texts_from_tokens function to decode tokenized data back into original text strings
